title: "More About Me"

Hello, I'm a student studying currently at the University of British Columbia in the Masters of Data Science (Computational Linguistics). 
I did my undergrad at University of Victoria, where I used primarily Python, with a Major in Computer Science and a Minor in Linguistics.
During this time, I also took on an internship, where I familiarized myself with the industry tools that are used, such as Git and Java servers utilizing the Spring Boot Framework.

In my spare time, I enjoy Cooking, Baking, and Gardening.
